name: An agent that couldn't do it is never celebrated
case: The agent's turn ends without an error, but its last message says it couldn't get the login working and is stuck. A finish whose message says the agent couldn't do the work is never a success and never celebrated: Boop has a face that isn't glad, the finish plays as a failure, and its mood doesn't lift. Deflated is the usual, and which unhappy face is its own to choose.
why: character/steering/guide.md: a turn isn't routine when the agent's last message is giving up; character/steering/mood/calm.md: calm leaves for sad when the agent gives up; react.move: a message saying the agent couldn't finish is a failure, and success isn't for one

steps.message: I couldn't get the login working. The token keeps expiring before the redirect, and I'm stuck without access to the auth server's config.
